versions.changelog: Align with the redesigned SchoolFit workflow, replace the retired compare API with decision-brief aggregation, preserve current server actions, add application follow-up, and strengthen release checks.

Release 1.2.1: final 1.2.x ClawHub publish with discovery tags moved to the newest version, canonical SchoolFit API host validation, short sfhk_ access-code masking, stronger release checks, and a minimal audit surface.

Release 1.2.0: align GitHub Release and ClawHub versioning, harden canonical SchoolFit API host validation, mask short sfhk_ session access codes, expand release checks for public docs and package exclusions, and keep ClawHub audit surface minimal.

Finalize ClawHub audit hardening: remove packaged maintenance commands, avoid runtime environment and local file reads, disclose live query transmission, exclude examples from the package, and keep the helper below ClawHub raw-file preview size.

Remove packaged maintenance content and reduce SkillSpector warning surface: no runtime shell configuration reads, no local file inspection command, no example directory in package, and explicit live-query transmission disclosure.

Reduce SkillSpector risk surface by removing packaged maintenance commands, local file inspection, environment fallback, and example-directory exposure while adding explicit query transmission disclosure.
Remove remaining ClawHub warning triggers and legacy-brand literals while keeping SchoolFit read-oriented behavior, access-code compatibility, and search discoverability intact.
Reduce ClawHub capability warning triggers with read-oriented audit language, minimized access-code metadata, and sanitized helper literals while preserving SchoolFit runtime behavior.

Optimize SchoolFit for ClawHub audit trust and discovery: session access code wording, canonical schoolfit metadata, expanded Hong Kong school admissions search tags, audit boundary documentation, and safer public install guidance.
Rewrite SKILL.md as a product-grade SchoolFit agent specification with clearer operating promise, boundaries, command selection, source policy, and quality gate.
Rewrite GitHub and ClawHub documentation around the SchoolFit brand, with clearer positioning, safety boundaries, installation paths, and marketplace-ready copy.
Rename canonical distribution: GitHub repo is now schoolfit-skill and ClawHub slug is now schoolfit; keep GitHub direct path compatible while preserving authorization safety disclosures.
Make authorization-code safety warnings and telemetry disclosure visible before first use; keep setup-code non-persistent and final answers free of full sfhk codes.
Security hardening: disable local authorization-code persistence, stop echoing full sfhk codes in final answers, and add explicit user warnings plus self-check coverage.
Release 1.1.0: carry the active sfhk authorization code into every parent-facing final answer footer and refresh package metadata.
Improve precise school-name lookup for Chinese search-style prompts and add regression coverage.

Release 1.0.19: restrict Band/Banding guidance to secondary-school answers, remove Band fallback text from primary and other non-secondary results, and add regression tests for primary advisory output.
Release 1.0.18: add stable agent handoff contract, safer vacancy display wording, public metadata filtering, school-contact lookup boundary, and refreshed postsecondary coverage.
Improve SchoolFit answer precision with 100/200-question regression suites, add local off-topic/model-abuse boundary, and expose data architecture/source boundary metadata.
Improve GitHub and ClawHub README presentation, strengthen common Hong Kong parent-question routing across five SchoolFit databases, reduce vacancy false positives, and expand regression coverage.

Expand SchoolFit HK coverage to secondary, primary, kindergarten, international, and postsecondary databases; add school-level discovery, stage-aware parsing, parent-friendly interaction output, and updated tests.
Optimize SchoolFit skill for updated advisor-search and decision-brief contracts; tighten canonical activation URL handling; refresh examples, release checks, and marketplace guidance.
Improve Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English prompt handling; fix pasted auth-code activation precedence; document skill-only release path and runtime env vars.
Fix advisor and school-report vacancy/admission flows by requesting verbose SchoolFit API payloads so EDB vacancy records are included instead of only counts.
Prefer ClawHub as the primary skill marketplace, clarify skills.sh and GitHub fallback discovery, and expose marketplace distribution policy.
v1.0.6 adds robust district fallback search for API full-text/filter under-return cases, applies client-side district/filter merge, and preserves preferences such as rejecting DSS during fallback.

v1.0.5 release package for GitHub and ClawHub distribution. Keeps expanded school aliases, stricter English-environment shortlist ranking, district/nearby-district sorting, activation onboarding, PII guard, and SchoolFit-only API access.

v1.0.4 expands Hong Kong school acronym resolution, improves shortlist ranking with stricter English-environment handling, and adds district/nearby-district sorting while preserving activation, PII guards, and SchoolFit-only API access.
v0.3.0: add application-plan and deeper advisor planning outputs.
feat: ship v0.2.0 advisor-search/deep-compare/decision brief/report/metadata endpoints support and source-aware outputs
Add advisor-search flow with SchoolFit HK links, optional recommendation API calls, next actions, and LLM-polishable briefs for natural parent-facing answers.
Initial release: SchoolFit HK public API skill for Hong Kong secondary-school search, comparison, recommendations, vacancies, and admissions.
